arStrings.szText:
Casting a {c_important}Focus{/c} Skill recalls all Nearby {c_important}{u}Storm Feathers{/u}{/c}, dealing {c_random}[(Owner.Weapon_Damage_Min_Total + Owner.Weapon_Damage_Delta_Total) * Affix_Value_1 * (1+Owner.Bonus_Percent_Per_Power#Spiritborn_Feather_Spawn)]{/c} Lightning damage and makes enemies {u}{c_important}Vulnerable{/c}{/u} for {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 1"]{/c} seconds. 

If you recall no {c_important}{u}Storm Feathers{/u}{/c}, spawn {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 0"]{/c} around you.
